reason: An opt-in DSH Web watchdog that monitors process health, relaunches failed instances, and optionally performs snapshot-checked workspace repairs after repeated startup failures.

summaries.zh: 一个可选启用的 DSH Web 进程看护插件，用于监控进程状态、自动重启并在需要时执行受快照保护的故障修复。
summaries.en: An opt-in DSH Web process watchdog that monitors health, relaunches failed instances, and can perform snapshot-checked repairs when startup failures repeat.

capabilities: Supervises and relaunches the DSH Web process
Can terminate the process listening on a configured port
Can modify plugin development workspaces through an optional repair agent
Reads startup diagnostics and inherited environment information
Exposes restart and status functionality through an HTTP API
